children: , the social-media and digital-advertising giant, climbed approximately 0.6% to $657.645 Thursday morning as Muse surged to No. 3 in Apple's U.S. App Store just two days after launch. JPMorgan added fuel by upgrading the stock from Neutral to Overweight and lifting its price target from $640 to $820.

Muse is built to do more than answer questions. The AI agent can coordinate calendars, message contacts, arrange trips, shop and handle multistep jobs across connected apps. U.S. customers can choose a free offering or pay $20 or $100 per month, while Meta says each user decides which services Muse can reach and keeps the agent's activity inside a dedicated virtual machine.

The chart shows the stock trading 22.67% below its GF Value estimate of $850.42, signaling potential upside if Muse develops into a durable business. Still, an App Store ranking measures early curiositynot customer loyalty or profitable transactions. Meta produced $60.80 billion in second-quarter revenue, but free cash flow shrank to $784 million as capital spending hit $31.08 billion. Muse now needs to prove it can generate recurring revenue instead of simply adding another expensive chapter to Meta's AI push.

title: Meta Shares Rise as Muse Cracks App Store's Top Three
